market_context.target_market: Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems (ADAS) and Autonomous Driving
market_context.growth_outlook: Strong growth driven by increasing vehicle automation levels and demand for enhanced safety features. The market is expected to mature by 2028, with significant opportunities for companies offering innovative perception solutions.

planned_roadmap.name: Functional Safety Certification (ISO 26262)
planned_roadmap.justification: Achieving ISO 26262 certification is critical for market access and building trust with automotive OEMs. This is a foundational step for STRADVISION's ADAS solutions.

planned_roadmap.name: AI Model Compression for Edge Deployment
planned_roadmap.justification: Optimizing AI models for edge deployment is essential for reducing computational requirements and enabling real-time performance on resource-constrained devices.

planned_roadmap.name: Chiplet-Based AI Accelerators
planned_roadmap.justification: Integrating chiplet-based AI accelerators will significantly improve the performance and scalability of STRADVISION's perception software.

planned_roadmap.name: High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) Integration
planned_roadmap.justification: Leveraging HBM will unlock the full potential of STRADVISION's software by providing faster data access and improved processing speeds.

planned_roadmap.name: Advanced Packaging for AI
planned_roadmap.justification: Developing advanced packaging solutions is crucial for integrating HBM and chiplets, enabling high performance and low power consumption.
